name: Lark (Larksuite)
description: Lark (Larksuite) is a collaboration suite with messaging, docs, calendar and an Open Platform for developers.
auth_notes: App Access Token (from app ID and secret) and User Access Token, per the MCP server description; exact OAuth or header details not in sources.
gate_detail: Sources say a registered Lark/Feishu app with permissions, App ID and App Secret is needed, but do not say how registration works or whether any plan, review or admin approval applies.
api_scope: Open Platform APIs covering messaging, group chats, docs, wiki, calendar, Bitable and contacts, as exposed through the MCP tools; API style itself is not described.
mcp_notes: Official lark-mcp npm package by larksuite, run locally over stdio or SSE; no hosted MCP URL stated. Other repos are community.
blocker_detail: Sources lack first-party developer docs on app registration, approval or plan requirements, so access path cannot be confirmed.

evidence.quote: It supports both App Access Token and User Access Token authentication, along with stdio and SSE transport modes.
Lark Mcp Server is an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool that encapsulates Feishu/Lark Open Platform APIs as MCP tools
A registered Lark/Feishu application with appropriate permissions
A Lark/Feishu application with App ID and App Secret

issues: No first-party developer docs among the sources; access prerequisites inferred from third-party MCP readmes.
S3 and S4 are community repositories, not first-party.
REST style, webhooks and sandbox are not stated.
